Why are running ddflow tasks slow on 2026-10-03, does it still match R-task-time, and how safely could they be sped up?
Review wall time (critic+rubber_duck LAN DeepSeek) is still ~60% of in-lease time; tests and roborev are minor; hot-file conflicts leave 2 of 4 slots idle; reviewer saturation is a secondary factor.
Each review call takes median ~9.5 min (2.2 min per 5000-char chunk at low load, ~3.3 at 8 concurrent calls); rounds beyond the 2nd cost ~15% of in-lease time and yield 23% of confirmed findings; conflicting globs (mcp.py held by B206, cli.py by B-view-cli-lists) block B-view-sessions, B194, B189, B-batch-integration and others.
